neighbours.label: the abstract thing granted after 'give': give access, give ascendance, give priority, give an opportunity
fire: We give access to all members.
Those cultures give ascendance to reason.
We give an opportunity of learning.
This will give access to the files.
They give priority to local firms.
The law gave power to the king.
It gives rise to new ideas.
quiet: We give money to all members.
Those cultures give food to guests.
We give a gift of flowers.
This will give a ride to the station.
They give candy to local kids.
The law gave land to the king.
It gives water to new plants.

notes: The + pole of this neuron is ' right to', ' opportunity to'.
